scripts.db:push: sh -c 'set -a; . ./.env.local; set +a; URL="$SUPABASE_DB_URL"; case "$SUPABASE_DB_API_URL" in postgres*) URL="$SUPABASE_DB_API_URL";; esac; [ -n "$URL" ] || { echo "No postgres:// connection string found in SUPABASE_DB_URL or SUPABASE_DB_API_URL"; exit 1; }; supabase db push --db-url "$URL"'
